## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: The report returns human decisions per merged change for each project and...

The system SHALL ensure that the report returns human decisions per merged change for each project and roadmap over a caller-specified time window.

#### Scenario: The report returns human decisions per merged change for each project and...

WHEN `report-human-decisions-per-merged-change` is implemented
THEN The report returns human decisions per merged change for each project and roadmap over a caller-specified time window.

### Requirement: Tier-auto resolutions and expired-to-default cards are excluded from the...

The system SHALL ensure that tier-auto resolutions and expired-to-default cards are excluded from the human count, verified by a fixture test.

#### Scenario: Tier-auto resolutions and expired-to-default cards are excluded from the...

WHEN `report-human-decisions-per-merged-change` is implemented
THEN Tier-auto resolutions and expired-to-default cards are excluded from the human count, verified by a fixture test.

### Requirement: The report runs from coordinator records alone without checking out any...

The system SHALL ensure that the report runs from coordinator records alone without checking out any repository.

#### Scenario: The report runs from coordinator records alone without checking out any...

WHEN `report-human-decisions-per-merged-change` is implemented
THEN The report runs from coordinator records alone without checking out any repository.
